Ocean worlds

Enceladus is not alone.

Europa

Jupiter's smooth ice moon hides perhaps twice Earth's volume of liquid water. NASA's Europa Clipper studies it from a sibling trajectory to AETHELON's.

Titan

Beneath its hazy nitrogen sky and methane lakes, Titan likely cradles a deep water-ammonia ocean — a second habitable layer on one moon.

Why ocean worlds

Liquid water, chemical energy and organics are the recipe for life. The outer Solar System turns out to be full of all three — hidden under ice.

AETHELON

An open deep-space outreach project tracing a robotic mission to Enceladus, Saturn's ocean moon. Figures are plausible mission estimates for educational use.
